name: ansible-codex
description: Reusable Ansible automation skills for Codex: playbook development, debugging, shell conversion, guided setup, linting, secrets, and collection management.

interface.shortDescription: Ansible playbook, debugging, linting, secrets, collections, conversion, and setup skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin that packages focused Ansible skills for creating playbooks and roles, diagnosing failures, converting shell automation into idempotent tasks, validating content with ansible-lint, managing secrets with Vault, handling collections, and guiding new project setup.
defaultPrompt: Use Ansible Codex to create an idempotent playbook for my infrastructure task.
Use Ansible Codex to debug this failing playbook output.
Use Ansible Codex to convert this shell setup script into Ansible.
Use Ansible Codex to lint and validate this Ansible role.
Use Ansible Codex to move these secrets into Ansible Vault.
